components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading
            '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time hint that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. When true, the duplicate-household check (same lastName and
            same address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) is
            bypassed so the owner can be created despite the collision. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation, equal to one more than the
                number of owners already in that city.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived and assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who deliberately share a
                household. Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true and an existing owner shares the same
                lastName and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace); every owner in that household carries the same value.
                Absent when the owner does not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Starts at
                1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at response time from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Derived at response time. 'true' when more than 80 owners have
                already been created on this owner's registration day, otherwise
                'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at response time.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (an absent email or
                householdId contributes an empty segment). All duplicate
                detection is consolidated into this one key: a create is rejected
                409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's. Derived at response time; not persisted.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page

## Summary

I implemented an optional, region-validated `postcode` field for owners across the OfficeFloor pipeline.

**What was added**
- **`openapi.yml`** — a `postcode` property on `OwnerFields` (used for both request binding and the `Owner` response), typed `string` with `pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"` and **not** in `required`. Because `performBeanValidation` is on, a malformed value (e.g. `"12"`) is rejected 400 by `@Valid` in the first `ValidateOwner` step, while absence is accepted — keeping the request contract backward-compatible.
- **`Owner` model** — `postcode` field with `@Column(name = "postcode")`, a matching `@Pattern`, and getter/setter. MapStruct maps it by name in both directions, so it's stored and returned automatically.
- **Schema DDL** — added the `postcode` column to all four `schema.sql` files (hsqldb — the test profile — plus h2, mysql, postgres).
- **`ValidateOwnerPostcode`** function — when a postcode is present and the city's region is known (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), it range-checks against NSW 2000-2099 / VIC 3000-3099 / QLD 4000-4099 and throws the checked `InvalidPostcodeException` (→ 400) when out of range. Absent postcode or unknown-region city is skipped, so any 4-digit postcode is accepted for cities with no known region.
- **`InvalidPostcodeException` + handler + escalation YAML** — mirrors the existing `InvalidAddress` pattern, responding 400 via `ProblemDetail`.
- Wired the new step into both `owners.POST.yml` and `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`, and updated `ApplyOwner` (the PUT path) to copy `postcode`.

**One bug caught and fixed during testing:** the initial `REGION_POSTCODES.get(CITY_REGION.get(city))` threw an NPE for unknown cities, since JDK `Map.of` immutable maps reject `get(null)`. I split the lookup to return early when the region is `null`.

- Wired the new step into both `owners.POST.yml` and `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`, and updated `ApplyOwner` (the PUT path) to copy `postcode`.

**One bug caught and fixed during testing:** the initial `REGION_POSTCODES.get(CITY_REGION.get(city))` threw an NPE for unknown cities, since JDK `Map.of` immutable maps reject `get(null)`. I split the lookup to return early when the region is `null`.
